description: Enrich system diagnostics with percentage normalization and nested structure parsing

script.source: if (ctx.usedHeapBytes != null && ctx.maxHeapBytes != null && ctx.maxHeapBytes > 0) { ctx.heapUtilization = (float)(ctx.usedHeapBytes * 100.0 / ctx.maxHeapBytes); }

if (ctx.storageUsage != null) { for (storage in ctx.storageUsage) { if (storage.totalSpaceBytes != null && storage.totalSpaceBytes > 0) { storage.usedSpaceBytes = storage.totalSpaceBytes - storage.freeSpaceBytes; storage.utilizationPercent = (float)(storage.usedSpaceBytes * 100.0 / storage.totalSpaceBytes); } } }
